annotations.title: G98, G99 or EV and heat pump notification?

description: For solar PV, batteries, V2G chargers, EV chargers and heat pumps in Great Britain: says which network operator process applies and when. Generation: G98 (fully type tested, 16 A / 3.68 kW per phase or less: install, then notify within 28 days) or G99 (apply and wait for acceptance before installing), counting existing generation and battery inverters. Demand: the ENA EV charge point and heat pump form (connect and notify within 28 days if every criterion is met, otherwise apply first), with each criterion marked true, false or null (not yet known). Returns `generation`, `demand`, `facts_to_put_on_the_form` (prefilled from inputs and `trade`), `missing_facts` and sources. Example: 5 kW solar plus a 5 kW battery inverter on single phase: {"supply_phases":1,"new_equipment":[{"type":"solar_pv","rating_kw":5,"type_tested":true},{"type":"battery","rating_kw":5,"type_tested":true}]}.

cut_out_rating_a.description: Network cut-out fuse rating, amps. Do not open the cut-out to find it.

existing_equipment.description: Generation, storage or chargers already at the premises, same shape as new_equipment.

export_limit_kw.description: Export limit if an export limiting scheme (G100) is fitted.

load_limiting_device.description: A load limiting or curtailment device keeps demand below the cut-out rating.

looped_service.description: The supply is looped with a neighbour.

max_demand_after_a.description: Premises maximum demand after the installation, amps per phase (from a load survey).

metered.description: The supply is metered (defaults to unknown).

mpan.description: Meter point administration number (the supply number on the bill).

multiple_premises.description: Part of several installations in a close area (housing development, street-wide scheme).

connect_and_notify_listed.description: Heat pumps: the model is marked Connect and Notify in the ENA heat pump database.

rating_kw.description: AC rating in kW: the inverter rating for PV and batteries, the charge rate for EV chargers, the maximum electrical input for heat pumps.

type_tested.description: Fully type tested and on the ENA Type Test Verification Report Register.

service_equipment_ok.description: No safety or adequacy concerns with the cut-out and service cable.

trade.description: Optional. The electrician's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1). Used to prefill certificate contractor fields and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Spark Pack.

address.description: Business address for the certificate contractor block.

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Bright Sparks Electrical".

licence_body.description: Competent person scheme the business is registered with.
